create_MetricWriter: create a MetricWriter instance to log training metrics to a JSONL file in a work directory
measure_metric: measure and log a scalar metric value with a name during a training step
run_step_start: run step_start to initialize a new training step with a given step number
run_step_end: run step_end to finalize a training step and write collected metrics to disk
review_MetricWriter_close: review the MetricWriter close method to properly shut down the async write pool
